admin_scraping_timing_provider_timeout_h: How long a single provider gets to respond before the scraper gives up on it and tries the next one.
admin_scraping_timing_overall_hint: The longest a single scrape can take, including providers running in parallel. Anything still running at that point is cancelled.
admin_scraping_timing_quality_hint: Once a result reaches this score, no more providers are tried. Title is worth 2, price 3, a real product photo 3 (a share card 1), and a description 1. The default of 8 keeps going until a result has a title, price, and photo. A lower value accepts results sooner and spends less on paid providers.
admin_scraping_timing_cache_hint: How long a successful scrape is reused for the same URL. Set to 0 to turn off caching.
admin_scraping_add_hint_ai: LLM extracts from any HTML; uses /admin/ai-settings creds
admin_scraping_providers_intro: Each entry only runs when it's configured and enabled. Tier 1 entries run in parallel. Tier 2 only runs if tier 1's combined result falls below the quality threshold, and so on. Pick a tier to move an entry between tiers.
admin_scraping_providers_empty: No scrapers configured. Click "Add scraper" to set one up.
admin_scraping_entry_name_hint: Shown as the header for this entry. Keep it short.
admin_scraping_entry_tier_hint: Lower tiers run first. Tier {next} only fires if tier {tier}'s merged result falls below the quality threshold.
admin_scraping_entry_tier_hint_last: Lower tiers run first. Tier {tier} only fires if tier {tier} falls below the quality threshold.
admin_scraping_browserless_token_hint: Sent as x-browser-token header and ?token query param. Encrypted at rest.
admin_scraping_flaresolverr_hint: Use this only for sites behind a Cloudflare wall. For everything else, the built-in fetcher or Browserless is faster and cheaper.
admin_scraping_browserbase_fetch_key_hin: Browserbase API key from {#link}browserbase.com/settings{/link}. Encrypted at rest.
admin_scraping_browserbase_proxies_hint: Routes the fetch through Browserbase's residential proxy network.
admin_scraping_browserbase_redirects_hin: Follow 3xx responses to the final URL before returning the body.
admin_scraping_browserbase_fetch_note: Uses Browserbase's Fetch API for fast rendered HTML. Best for mostly static pages that benefit from running JavaScript but don't need an LLM to extract the details.
admin_scraping_stagehand_key_hint: Browserbase API key. Encrypted at rest.
admin_scraping_stagehand_model_hint: Override the LLM model used by Stagehand's extract(). Leave blank to use the app's AI settings (provider, model, and key).
admin_scraping_stagehand_instruction_pla: Extract the product title, current price, currency, main image URLs, and the site's display name.
admin_scraping_stagehand_instruction_hin: Optional instructions for the extractor, in plain language. Leave blank to use the default product-page instructions.
admin_scraping_stagehand_note: Drives a real Browserbase session and uses Stagehand's extract() to produce a structured ScrapeResult. It's slower, each run is billed as an LLM call, and it runs in parallel with the rest of the chain.
admin_scraping_giftwrapt_endpoint_hint_l: Base URL of your deployed {#link}giftwrapt-scraper{/link} service.
admin_scraping_giftwrapt_endpoint_hint: Base URL of your deployed giftwrapt-scraper service.
admin_scraping_giftwrapt_token_hint: Sent as {#code}X-Browser-Token{/code} on every request. Encrypted at rest.
admin_scraping_scrapfly_key_hint: ScrapFly API key from {#link}scrapfly.io/dashboard{/link}. Encrypted at rest.
admin_scraping_scrapfly_asp_hint: Sends asp=true. Gets through most bot protection, but costs more credits per call.
admin_scraping_scrapfly_render_js_hint: Sends render_js=true to render the page in a headless browser. Slower, and uses significantly more credits per call.
admin_scraping_ai_note: Uses the default AI model configured under {#code}/admin/ai{/code}. It reads the page an earlier tier already fetched, or fetches it itself when there is none, then makes one model call, so every scrape costs money. Works best in a higher tier, as a fallback when cheaper providers come up short.
admin_scraping_ai_web_fetch_hint: When the page it has does not give what is still missing (or it has no page), the AI provider's own servers fetch the URL and the model reads that. Adds up to two model calls per scrape. Only works when the default AI provider is Anthropic; on any other provider this does nothing.
admin_scraping_custom_headers_hint: Sent on every request to this scraper. One {#code}{example}{/code} per line. Blank lines and {#code}{hash}{/code}-prefixed comments are ignored. Encrypted at rest, since headers often carry bearer tokens.
admin_scraping_custom_kind_html_help: Return the raw HTML body of the page (a {#code}text/html{/code} response). The scraper runs the same OpenGraph, JSON-LD, and microdata extraction it uses for the built-in fetcher.
admin_scraping_custom_kind_json_help: Return JSON with the {#code}ScrapeResult{/code} shape. Unknown fields are ignored, and missing fields are treated as "not provided." Every field is optional. A response with at least {#code}title{/code} or {#code}{imageField}{/code} usually scores well enough to win.
admin_scraping_timeout_override_hint: Leave blank to use the global per-provider timeout above. Set a longer value for slow scrapers (Stagehand, AI) without raising the timeout for every other provider.
admin_scraping_detail_description: The saved record from the item_scrapes table. Use it to debug provider responses.
admin_scraping_stats_empty: No scrape attempts from your current providers in this time range.

match.aPlural=*, bPlural=one: {urls} unique URLs from {failures} failure in this window. Click a URL to copy.
match.aPlural=*, bPlural=*: {urls} unique URLs from {failures} failures in this window. Click a URL to copy.

admin_ai_env_set_by_change: Set by {envVar}. Unset to change here.
admin_ai_env_set_by_edit: Set by {envVar}. Unset to edit here.
admin_ai_slot_missing_model: Pick a model for this provider.
admin_ai_slot_missing_key: Enter the API key for this provider.
admin_ai_slot_misconfigured: This slot names a provider but is missing its key, model or base URL, so these features are running on the default model.
admin_ai_slot_own_provider_hint: Off, this slot runs on {provider} with the key above. On, it gets its own provider and key.
admin_ai_slot_api_key_hint: The key for this provider. Encrypted at rest. The key above is not used.
admin_ai_slot_model_hint_default: A model {provider} offers. Leave it empty to use the default model.
admin_ai_slot_env_locked: Some fields are set by {pattern} environment variables and can't be edited here.
admin_ai_rate_hint: Optional. {#mono}{model}{/mono} isn't in the built-in price list, so usage estimates and the monthly ceiling assume $3 in and $15 out per 1M tokens unless you enter its price.
admin_ai_rate_invalid: Enter both prices as numbers, or leave both empty.
admin_ai_settings_description: Set up the AI provider used to clean up scraped results and to generate Intelligence recommendations. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. Values set through environment variables take priority and can't be edited here.
admin_ai_settings_provider_hint: Pick OpenAI, Anthropic, a known OpenAI-compatible provider, or Custom to point at any other endpoint.
admin_ai_settings_base_url_hint: The chat-completions API root, without a trailing slash. Example: {example}
admin_ai_settings_api_key_hint: Bearer token sent to the provider. Encrypted at rest.
admin_ai_settings_model_hint: Pick a model this provider currently offers, or type any identifier it accepts.
admin_ai_settings_shared_description: Settings that apply to every AI feature. Provider-specific options will show up here as they're added.
admin_ai_settings_max_tokens_hint: Caps the response length for connection tests, scraping, title clean-up, and photo to item. Reasoning models need at least a few hundred. Suggestions are bounded by batch size instead, because a cut-off response there is unusable.
admin_ai_settings_max_tokens_invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 64000.
admin_ai_test_description: Sends a small chat request through the Vercel AI SDK to verify the provider, API key, and model in one round-trip.
admin_ai_test_description_dirty: Sends a small chat request through the Vercel AI SDK to verify the provider, API key, and model in one round-trip. Uses the values currently in the form (including unsaved drafts).
admin_ai_usage_empty: No AI calls in the last {days} days.
admin_ai_usage_details_toggle: Where calls came from, and recent calls
admin_ai_usage_description: Every AI call this deployment made in the last 30 days, by feature. Costs are estimates from token counts, not a bill from your provider.
admin_ai_usage_ceiling_hint: When this month’s estimated spend reaches the ceiling, AI features stop until next month. Leave empty for no ceiling.
admin_ai_usage_ceiling_hint_spend: When this month’s estimated spend reaches the ceiling, AI features stop until next month. Leave empty for no ceiling. This month so far: {cost}.
admin_ai_usage_ceiling_invalid: Enter an amount between 0 and 100000, or leave it empty.
admin_ai_usage_ceiling_reached: The ceiling has been reached. AI features are paused until next month or until you raise it.
admin_ai_features_disclosure_toggle: What is sent to the AI provider
admin_ai_features_search_hint: Adds a Search link to each idea. Enter any search or store URL with {placeholder} where the idea’s title should go. Leave empty for no link.
admin_ai_features_search_invalid: Enter an http(s) URL that contains {placeholder}, or leave it empty.
admin_ai_features_description: Each feature below can be switched on its own. The badge says which model it runs on: Default is the provider at the top, Fast and Vision are the optional models above and fall back to Default when empty. Open “What is sent” to see exactly what leaves this deployment for that feature. Nothing runs until a provider is configured.
admin_ai_features_unavailable: Configure an AI provider above to enable these features.
admin_ai_model_picker_search: Search or type a model id…
admin_ai_model_picker_status_idle: Add an API key and refresh to list the models {provider} currently offers.
admin_ai_model_picker_status_error_fallb: Couldn't list models from {provider} ({error}). Showing known models.
admin_ai_model_picker_status_error_typed: Couldn't list models from {provider} ({error}). Type a model id to use it anyway.
admin_photo_description: Upload a product photo to check that your AI model can extract a ScrapeResult. This uses the same endpoint as the Upload Photo option when adding an item, and counts against your per-user rate limit.
admin_storage_truncated: The bucket scan stopped at the {count}-object limit, so the counts above don't include everything. Bulk delete is turned off while the scan is incomplete.
admin_storage_delete_blocked_title: Cannot delete: still attached to a row
admin_storage_bulk_too_large: Bucket is too large to bulk-delete from the UI. Run a one-shot script instead.
admin_storage_not_configured_server: Storage is not configured on this server.

match.countPlural=one: This will permanently delete {count} object from the bucket. This cannot be undone.
match.countPlural=*: This will permanently delete {count} objects from the bucket. This cannot be undone.

admin_storage_delete_confirm_attached: This object is still referenced by a database row. Deleting will leave that row pointing at a broken URL.
admin_storage_delete_confirm_orphan: This object is not referenced by any database row.
admin_storage_delete_in_use: Object is still referenced by a row.
